title: TAT-3848 — Perps tab market category pills
description: Proves the Perps tab renders a horizontally scrollable rail of MMDS ButtonFilter category pills, that tapping one lands on the market list pre-filtered to that category, that the rail is skeleton-gated while market data loads, and that every pill is a focusable native button inside a labelled group.

gate-cdp-reachable.intent: Refuse to report proof unless the live extension is actually attached

setup-open-perps-tab.intent: Put the user on the Perps tab, the surface the category rail is added to

setup-wait-perps-tab.intent: Hold until the Perps tab has finished its initial market load so the rail is judged on real data

setup-scroll-rail-into-view.intent: Bring the category rail into the viewport so the proof is judged on what a user can actually see

ac1-wait-category-rail.intent: The category rail is on screen for the user, not merely in the document

ac1-assert-horizontal-scroller.intent: The rail scrolls horizontally rather than wrapping or clipping its pills

ac1-wait-all-pill.intent: The rail offers the All shortcut back to the unfiltered market list

ac1-wait-crypto-pill.intent: The rail offers a real category derived from the live market data

ac1-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Keep the upcoming capture on the real screenshot provider instead of a silent fallback

ac1-screenshot-category-rail.label: AC1: Perps tab shows the category pill rail with All and Crypto
ac1-screenshot-category-rail.intent: Show the reader the pill rail as it appears on the Perps tab

ac4-assert-pill-is-focusable-button.intent: Each pill is a real enabled button, so Tab reaches it and Enter or Space activates it

ac4-assert-rail-is-labelled-group.intent: A screen reader announces the rail as one named group rather than loose buttons

ac2-press-crypto-pill.intent: Take the route a user takes when they want to browse only crypto markets

ac2-wait-market-list.intent: The pill landed the user on the full market list page

ac2-assert-filter-preselected.intent: The market list arrived already narrowed to Crypto instead of the default All

ac2-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Keep the upcoming capture on the real screenshot provider instead of a silent fallback

ac2-screenshot-market-list-filtered.label: AC2: market list opened from the Crypto pill with the Crypto filter already applied
ac2-screenshot-market-list-filtered.intent: Show the reader that the destination page arrived pre-filtered

ac3-run-skeleton-gating-test.intent: Show that the loading pass reserves the rail's final height so nothing jumps when data arrives

ac3-assert-skeleton-test-ran.intent: Refuse to count a title filter that silently matched nothing as proof

ac3-assert-skeleton-test-passed.intent: The skeleton gating assertion actually passed

ac4-run-keyboard-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/perps-market-categories/perps-market-categories.test.tsx --no-coverage -t 'navigates to the filtered market list when a pill is activated from the keyboard' 2>&1
ac4-run-keyboard-test.intent: Show that a keyboard-only user can reach and fire a pill, not just a mouse user

ac4-assert-keyboard-test-ran.intent: Refuse to count a title filter that silently matched nothing as proof

ac4-assert-keyboard-test-passed.intent: The keyboard activation assertion actually passed

teardown-return-to-perps-tab.intent: Leave the wallet back on the Perps tab for the next run
